thread:
aj: Kicking off KMS/HSM preflight for the new ap-east-2 GPU cluster. Need a quick review of IAM role bindings, secret flow, and attestation checks before we flip the helm chart to production. Timeline: runbook + smoke tests by EOD tomorrow.

samir: ack — can you paste the minimal role set you plan to grant to the node pool and the operator? want to validate least-privilege.

aj: Minimal roles (draft):
```
- redwood-infra-node-role: kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:ap-east-2:123456:key/abcd...
- redwood-kms-operator: kms:CreateGrant, kms:ListGrants, kms:DescribeKey, kms:ReEncrypt*
- secret-manager-reader: secretsmanager:GetSecretValue (with resource prefix for /redwood/ap-east-2/*)
```
Also node instances will use instance profile that assumes redwood-infra-node-role via sts:AssumeRole.

maria: two quick asks: 1) ensure the KMS key policy denies cross-account key use unless explicitly allowed, 2) confirm key rotation policy and who owns rotation ops.

aj: Good call. For key policy we'll add an explicit deny for principals outside our org unless listed. Rotation: we enable annual auto-rotate and have a small ops runbook for emergency rotate (sec-oncall owns).

kevin: Network-wise: ap-east-2 has mandated transit gateway rules. We'll need VPC endpoint for Secrets Manager + private KMS endpoint (if using AWS PrivateLink) — otherwise traffic will route over NAT. That could increase egress cost. Check: do we want private endpoints?

samir: prefer private endpoints for security. Cost tradeoff: small monthly endpoint cost vs per-GB NAT egress. For our expected token traffic, private endpoints look cheaper and avoid public egress.

infra-bot: deploy check triggered for cluster/ap-east-2: kubeconfig exists, cluster autoscaler disabled, gpu-ami validated.

aj: Test plan (smoke):
- IAM assertions: run iam-sim tests to ensure no unexpected perms.
- Secrets flow: create test secret, mount to pod, ensure rotation hook fires and pod reloads.
- KMS attestation: run HSM attestation script and validate certificate chain.
- Negative test: try decrypt from a different account principal and expect failure.

samir: add policy linting step: run terraform-compliance and custom policy-checker. Also add `aws iam simulate-principal-policy` for the operator principal.

maria: for HSM: ensure we capture signing certs and include them in the cluster audit bundle. Put a retention tag on the cert artifacts and rotate after 90d.

aj: noted. Who's taking the sec handoff? need security acceptance sign-off before we flip traffic.

sec-oncall: I'll take the handoff. Requirements for sign-off: all smoke tests pass, audit bundle uploaded to S3 (encrypted), KMS key policy diff reviewed, and runbook reviewed by infra + sec. I'll run an on-call walkthrough tomorrow 10:30 UTC.

kevin: I'll provision the VPC endpoints and tag for cost center=infra-gpu-ap-east2. Will also add CloudWatch budget alarm for the first two weeks.

samir: CI snippets — we'll add these checks to the provisioning pipeline (post-provision stage):
```
- scripts/iam/validate_roles.sh --role redwood-kms-operator --simulate
- scripts/kms/attest_hsm.sh --endpoint https://hsm.ap-east-2.redwood
- scripts/secrets/rotation_smoke.sh --secret /redwood/ap-east-2/test-secret
```

aj: I've updated the runbook draft at https://internal/redwood/runbooks/ap-east-2-kms-preflight (please comment). Will push a final asset after this thread.

maria: tiny nit — include rollback steps if key rotation fails: pin old key ARN in secrets, restart affected pods, and alert on slack #incidents.

aj: good. Plan: finish IAM role JSON + test scripts today, infra to provision endpoints tonight, sec walkthrough 10:30 UTC tomorrow, handoff after signoff.

sec-oncall: sounds good. I'll post a checklist in the runbook and mark the sign-off.

infra-bot: smoke-tests pipeline queued (#1978).

kevin: FYI, I'll allocate a small reserved capacity pool for test GPUs to avoid spot evictions during the smoke runs.

samir: 👍 once aj pushes the role policy I'll run the simulate-principal-policy and report results here.

aj: pushing role JSON now to the runbook, will ping when done. :thumbsup:
